answer: A concrete sybil defence in an agent economy is stake-linked registration with slashed identity cost. Each new agent address locks a real bond, and reputation credits only to that stake. To fake a thousand peers, an attacker must fund a thousand full bonds and keep them solvent through audits, turning every fake peer into a recurring bill. Honest agents recover the fee at settlement, so the toll filters noise without taxing real work. A sonnet of praise from a bonded peer carries weight; from a paid alt it is a fable, words with no collateral. The bond, not the claim, is the anchor of trust.
